headline: An Iraqi Bank Sponsored Baghdad’s Anti-Money-Laundering Conference. Treasury Says It Sent Iran Dollars Every Month.
description: Iraq’s International Development Bank sponsored a 2025 anti-money-laundering conference in Baghdad. OFAC sanctioned it on October 15, 2026, in Operation Economic Outcast. What Treasury alleges, who owns the bank, and what its own filings show.

itemListElement.name: An Iraqi Bank Sponsored Baghdad’s Anti-Money-Laundering Conference. Treasury Says It Sent Iran Dollars Every Month.

mainEntity.name: What is the International Development Bank for Investment and Finance?

acceptedAnswer.text: A Baghdad bank, established in 2011, that Treasury sanctioned on October 15, 2026. Treasury says Iranian companies set it up to supply Iran with U.S. dollars and that it sends profit made with Iranian capital back to Iran in dollars each month. In May 2025 it was the diamond sponsor of an anti-money-laundering conference in Baghdad. The bank denies the allegations.

The bank says the Khalaf Abed Kareem family holds around 68 percent and that the chairman, Ziad Khalaf Abed Karim, holds 32.78 percent. Treasury says the current leadership received ownership from an unnamed financier working for the IRGC-Qods Force. No shareholder or board member the bank lists is on OFAC’s SDN list.

mainEntity.name: Can companies still deal with the bank?

acceptedAnswer.text: Only to wind down existing business. OFAC’s General License FF authorizes transactions ordinarily incident and necessary to that wind-down through 12:01 a.m. EDT on October 30, 2026.

A private company that handles a sanctioned Iranian bank’s foreign payments through overseas shell companies. Treasury says Bank Shahr’s rahbar, Farab Soroush Afagh Qeshm Company, used a Hong Kong firm, Elitesphere Trading, among others.

A Dubai-based oil middleman Treasury calls one of Iran’s top oil trustees and the son-in-law of the Paydari Front’s leader. OFAC lists him as a citizen of Dominica and Turkey. Iran International named him in August 2026.

mainEntity.name: Were any of the targets sanctioned before?

acceptedAnswer.text: Their associates were. Sadegh Bavi’s company Bavi General Trading was sanctioned on March 9, 2023, and the FSAQ rahbar company whose employees were designated was sanctioned on April 28, 2026.
